people.name: Ashtaroth
people.line: A city of Og, king of Bashan.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Golan
people.line: A city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to Manasseh.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;
translations.bsb: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
